create_InGraphBatchEnv: create an InGraphBatchEnv instance wrapping a batch environment for TensorFlow graph integration
simulate_InGraphBatchEnv: simulate a batch of environments by stepping with action tensors inside the TF graph
reset_InGraphBatchEnv: reset the batch of environments and return new observations for specified indices
review_InGraphBatchEnv_properties: review the observ, action, reward, and done properties to access current environment state variables
close_InGraphBatchEnv: close the InGraphBatchEnv to send close messages to external processes and join them
